title: The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit
original_title: The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit
overview: On Halloween night in 1983, four friends enter the long-abandoned Waterman House near Nash-Lake, drawn by curiosity and the local legends. As they explore the dark hallways and forgotten rooms, they are overcome by the feeling that they are being watched. Something is lurking in this old home.
